# Embedding / feature environment: src/umda_pipeline/ and scripts/features/ (the mol2vec -> PCA(70)
# embedding of the umda pipeline, the Gaussian-process fit, and the feature recomputation).
#
# Python 3.10 specifically. The pretrained regressors shipped in the umda repository
# (models/regressors.pkl) unpickle only under scikit-learn==1.0.2 (newer versions change the internal
# format of the stored decision trees and remove private APIs that mol2vec / dask-ml still import), and
# scikit-learn 1.0.2 has no wheel for Python 3.11 or later. This is why the release has two environments.
#
# Three steps are not expressible in a requirements file and are done by env/install_embedding_env.sh
# (see env/README_env.md): installing the mol2vec fork with --no-deps, overwriting
# site-packages/mol2vec/features.py with env/mol2vec_features_patched.py, and applying a one-line
# np.float / np.int alias fix to site-packages/dask_ml/_typing.py.
# Install:  bash env/install_embedding_env.sh .venv-embed

numpy==1.26.4
gensim==4.4.0
rdkit==2026.3.6
pandas==2.3.3
scipy==1.15.3
joblib==1.6.0
dask==2026.8.0
dask-ml==1.8.0
numba==0.67.0
llvmlite==0.49.0
h5py==3.16.0
loguru==0.7.3
networkx==3.4.2
bokeh==3.9.2
tqdm==4.70.1
# pkg_resources is needed to unpickle umda's EmbeddingModel.pkl; it was removed from setuptools 81+
setuptools==80.9.0
scikit-learn==1.0.2

# gensim>=4.0-compatible fork of mol2vec, pinned to a commit. Installed by env/install_embedding_env.sh with
# --no-deps, because the fork's setup.py still pins gensim==3.8.3:
#   mol2vec @ git+https://github.com/laserkelvin/mol2vec.git@850d944d5f48a58e26ed0264332b5741f72555aa

# umda itself (https://github.com/laserkelvin/umda, commit a95cc1c1eb98a1ff64b37a4c6ed92f9546d0215b) is not
# a pip dependency: fetch it as described in data/raw/FETCH.md; the code only needs its models/ directory
# and the package on PYTHONPATH (needed to unpickle EmbeddingModel.pkl).
